FAQs

Questions before booking

Can I book an ambulance from Hyderabad to another state?

Yes, you can enquire about interstate transfers. Share the exact pickup and destination addresses so the team can confirm availability and arrangements.

Do you provide ICU or oxygen ambulances?

Please call to confirm the appropriate vehicle and equipment for the patient's needs. Availability may vary by date, route and requirements.

How is the outstation ambulance fare calculated?

Fare may depend on distance, ambulance type, equipment, staff requirements, waiting time and whether a return journey is needed. Confirm the total fare and inclusions before booking.

What information should I provide when calling?

Keep the pickup and destination addresses, travel date/time, patient's mobility and medical support needs, and a contact person's phone number ready.

Can I book in advance?

Yes, contact us in advance with your preferred schedule. The booking is subject to confirmation of vehicle and crew availability.

For a medical emergency, contact local emergency services immediately. This website provides ambulance booking information and does not replace medical advice or emergency dispatch.
